global_dependencies: Verify current parcel R2 zoning and special site-specific amendments; an R2 label alone is not parcel proof.
Part 3 section 3.08.03(1) excludes the OCP City Centre designation; map/version overlay is unresolved.
Part 3 sections 3.08.01 and 3.08.03 add suite count, occupancy, parking, servicing, driveway, placement, and other conditions; these five checks are not complete permission.
Part 6 section 6.22.04 has alternative dwelling forms and lot-area bands; keep this one-family garden-suite pathway coherent.
Part 3 section 3.08.04(1) has an express Part 6 exception; whether an R2 override applies requires independent review.
Official consolidated text is for convenience only; amendment commencement and full currentness remain independently unverified.
